ambient_events: The floor here is a shifting carpet of nesting-litter and gnawed bone.
Dozens of small eyes catch your light at once, then scatter.
The stench of rat is a physical wall you have to push through.
description: A drowned side-chamber the rats have made their own: a stinking warren of shredded nesting packed into every ledge and pipe-gap, the floor churned to filth. This is the heart of the colony. They do not take kindly to the light, or to you.
name: Rat Warren
